work.title: Untitled (Page on Bands)
work.description: Mixed-media collage centered on a white rectangular panel bearing scattered paint marks and handwritten text, overlaid on vertical yellow bands; surrounding field incorporates concentric target motifs, compact discs, printed ephemera, black brushwork, and fragments of photographic and grid-patterned materials in red, blue, gold, and black.
work.composition: central blank panel on roundel field, disc base
